coverage: LLVM source coverage of TagLib built from the pinned release; MPEG frame-header scanning in taglib/mpeg/mpegheader.cpp and mpegproperties.cpp
coverage_limit: Untagged MPEG Layer III only. TagLib parses frame headers (and Xing/VBRI when present) to report audio properties; it does not decode Layer III audio, so main data, Huffman and synthesis are not exercised. For CBR streams without a Xing/VBRI header the length is derived from stream size and the first frame's bitrate. Two valid CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, or MPEG-2.5 support. TagLib is also counted under mp3_id3v2/cpp for ID3v2 scope; this path is the plain-frame property scope.
